title: Understanding the Plot
text: The violin plot is used to visualize the distribution of a dataset. In this case, it shows the distribution of $$`ed_{hours}`$$ for different combinations of `role` and $$`is_{graduating}`$$. Think about which variable should be on the x-axis to separate these groups.
